name: Failure of the busiest hop-1 router
description: After the network has formed and is stable: per-hop RTT baseline and capacity search; the hop-1 router with the largest subtree switched off at 50 % of the capacity (detection, repair, losses, parent changes); capacity recheck after the repair; the router switched back on at 50 % of the capacity until it is back in the border router's routing table.
